doc_title: APPLICATION FOR ISSUE OF A CERTIFICATE OF TITLE/LEASE*
doc_title_official: APPLICATION FOR ISSUE OF A CERTIFICATE OF TITLE/LEASE*
when_used: The registered proprietor applies to the Land Registrar for the issue of a certificate of title or a certificate of lease.

detail_rows.label: ID/Passport/Company Registration No. of the Proprietor(if any)

body_text.text: The Proprietor HEREBY APPLIES for the issue of the above Certificate of Title /Lease*
In support of this Application, the Proprietor has attached statutory declaration and supporting documents.

execution.verification_heading: Certificate of Verification under section 45 of the Land Registration Act, 2012

annex.heading: STATUTORY DECLARATION***
annex.intro: I, {{declarant_name}} (in support of this Application) do hereby sincerely declare as follows:-
annex.closing: I make this declaration conscientiously believing the same to be true and according to the Oaths and Statutory Declaration Act.
annex.jurat_signatory: Signature of Commissioner for Oaths or Magistrate or Notary Public

foot_notes: *** one of the supporting documents must be a police abstract.

custom_fields.name: declarant_name
custom_fields.label: Name of the declarant
custom_fields.prompt: Full name of the person swearing the statutory declaration in support of this application
